# Data Lake & Data Governance

The **CINAS Data Lake** is the data engineering backbone of our research group, consolidating large-scale public and governmental datasets to empower research in Artificial Intelligence, epidemiology, public health, and predictive models in radiation and medical sciences.

Built on the **Medallion Architecture** (Bronze, Silver, and Gold), we convert legacy source formats into high-performance columnar data (**Apache Parquet** with **ZSTD** compression), orchestrated with dimensional star-schemas and sub-second analytics via **DuckDB**.
:::

## Integrated Data Providers {.mb-4}

::: {.grid .mb-5}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
::: {.card .h-100 .shadow-sm .border-0 .p-3}
### {{< fa hospital >}} DATASUS
**Brazilian Ministry of Health**
Complete curation of hospital admissions (SIHSUS), outpatient services (SIASUS), disease surveillance (SINAN), healthcare facilities registry (CNES), mortality data (SIM), and live births (SINASC). Lock-free conversion from legacy DBC/CSV to Parquet.
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
::: {.card .h-100 .shadow-sm .border-0 .p-3}
### {{< fa cloud-sun >}} INMET
**National Institute of Meteorology**
Hourly and daily historical records from over 700 meteorological stations across all 27 Brazilian states (from 2008 to present), allowing correlation of climatic variables with health outcomes.
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
::: {.card .h-100 .shadow-sm .border-0 .p-3}
### {{< fa users >}} IBGE & Demographics
**Brazilian Institute of Geography and Statistics**
Census 2022 micro-aggregates (5,570 municipalities and 468k+ census sectors), official demographic projections 2000-2070, and annual population estimates.
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
::: {.card .h-100 .shadow-sm .border-0 .p-3}
### {{< fa shield-halved >}} ANS (Supplementary Health)
**National Supplementary Health Agency**
Registry of active private health plan operators (CADOP), beneficiary enrollments (SIB), and financial/accounting records (DIOPS).
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
::: {.card .h-100 .shadow-sm .border-0 .p-3}
### {{< fa pills >}} CMED & ANVISA
**Pharmaceutical Market Regulation**
Maximum price regulations (consumer and hospital procurement) and standardized drug presentations dimensional catalog.
:::
:::

:::
